decisions.reason: The FAQ still describes Big Block tickets, prizes, delivery amounts, and the former primary-mint allocation, all of which necessarily change when Big Blocks are removed and the $15 split becomes $5/$5/$5.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey [FREELANCER_NAME_001], I’d like to remove the big blocks and redirect that extra $1 to me, making the split:
$15 buy, $5 to me, $5 to affiliate, $5 to block prize pool.

This improves my bottom line while having minimal effect on sales.
It also makes the game mechanics and marketing simpler.

An even split between me and every community member, together with everyone having an equal chance at the never-ending $500 prizes, seems consistent with the project’s ethos.

value_updates.referral_ticket_copy: Each successful code-used mint gives the referrer one Small Block ticket, with more tickets providing more opportunities to win.
value_updates.pool_funding_copy: Every mint and secondary sale funds the Small Block prize pool indefinitely.
value_updates.reward_delivery_copy: Commissions are sent automatically to the buyer's wallet; prize winners are shown on the Winners page, notified through dashboard and email, and receive the $500 prize directly in their wallet.
value_updates.no_referral_allocation_copy: When no referral code is entered, the commission and a Small Block ticket go to a random existing NFT holder.
value_updates.fiat_buyer_rewards_copy: Add a dedicated FAQ explaining that Transak creates a non-custodial wallet without an initial seed phrase, mints the NFT to it, supplies referral and dashboard details by email, allows dashboard access through the email link or SIWE, automatically receives $5 commissions and Small Block prize tickets, and provides dashboard and email winner notifications.
value_updates.anti_scam_copy: The model is single-level with verified source code on Basescan; each $15 primary mint is split $5 to the founder, $5 to the affiliate, and $5 to the Small Block prize pool. The founder's previously specified $4 share from each secondary sale remains subject to applicable fiat fees.

decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the new $5-per-mint allocation to the remaining Small Block pool; no additional Small Block state change is required.
The About page explicitly advertises Big Block tickets and draws, so removing Big Blocks necessarily requires its process copy to describe only the remaining Small Block mechanism.

process_items.label: Mint the ebook NFT
process_items.copy: Buy your ebook NFT for $15 USD. The mint number you receive becomes your referral code.

process_items.label: Earn Through Referrals
process_items.copy: Share either your mint number or your link. Whenever someone mints with it, you immediately earn $5 USD. There are no limits and no expiration. If no code is provided → the $5 and one Small Block ticket are awarded to a random existing ticket holder.

process_items.label: Build Up Tickets
process_items.copy: Every referral also awards you a Small Block prize ticket for the current block. More referrals = more tickets = greater chances.

process_items.label: Enter the Prize Draws
process_items.copy: Small Block: 5 × $500 awarded every 500 sales. (Sales = mint + secondary) Chainlink VRF selects the winners randomly and fairly.

process_items.label: Receive Your Rewards
process_items.copy: Commissions are delivered automatically on-chain. Prize wins are posted on the Winners page and can be claimed with one click whenever you're ready.

decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already limits no-referral ticket allocation to SMALL_BLOCK, fully reflecting the removal of Big Blocks.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes both Big Block ticket-issuance attributes while preserving the Small Block issuance rules.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block ticket counter and leaves the Small Block counter intact.
Removing Big Blocks does not change the Winners page, dashboard, or email channels used to announce and notify winners of the remaining prizes.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the $15 price, $5 founder share, $5 referral commission, $5 Small Block pool share, and removal of Big Block as an active pool destination.
The removal of Big Blocks changes which prizes exist but does not change the automatic direct-wallet delivery mode for the remaining Small Block prize.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block ticket-counter metadata attribute.
The source preserves a $5 affiliate allocation and does not change the rule assigning the no-referral commission to a random existing NFT holder.
The public API must still expose the values of active prize pools; reducing the system to one pool does not change the publication behavior.
